reason: MLVTG combines a Vision Mamba backbone (MambaAligner) with frozen LLM layers (LLMRefiner) to localize video clips for natural-language queries on QVHighlights/Charades-STA; a video temporal grounding task model.
title: MLVTG: Mamba-Based Feature Alignment and LLM-Driven Purification for Multi-Modal Video Temporal Grounding
